name: What's Up Docker
description: Gets you notified when new versions of your Docker containers are available and lets you react the way you want.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-wud application
services:
  # Service definition for the main application
  app:
    image: fmartinou/whats-up-docker:6.6.1@sha256:7cbdfa9bb56de7ad820e3efea16205c3cf09e5f06192436530c5c798964607f0
    container_name: wud
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
